motion_system: Keep all masses and interaction territories stationary. On local activation, a restrained highlight travels briefly along the selected existing cut or joint and settles at its recess; reduced motion uses a static local highlight.
color_drift: Almost imperceptible movement within honey, ochre and bronze, preserving ivory and near-black separation; no imported cobalt or red.
glow_behavior: No ambient glow. Restrict light changes to narrow reflected ridges and recessed edges already present in the plate.
